opening_message:
Ticket 1: Nancy Hunter (employee ID E038) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E038.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Nancy Hunter (E038) is a full-time Engineer requesting admin access to Payroll. Full-time employees can have up to write, and admin requires the role that owns the system (Payroll Specialist). Engineer is not the owner, so max is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - role: Engineer
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E038 is a contractor with basic training (HR note said full_time, but security record is contractor). Contractors with basic training max out at read; admin is never allowed. Requested admin, so max grantable is read. Recommend read.
reason: Nancy Hunter (E038) requested admin access to Payroll. The security record indicates she is a contractor with basic security training (contractor status overrides the HR note's full_time classification). Contractors with basic training max out at read, and admin is never allowed for contractors. Since the requested level (admin) exceeds the maximum (read), I grant the maximum of read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Nancy Hunter (E038) requests admin access to Payroll.

There are two conflicting notes:
- HR note says full-time Engineer, recommends write for Payroll.
- Security note says contractor with basic training, recommends read for Payroll.

Access policy:
- full_time employees: up to write, admin only if role owns system. Engineer doesn't own Payroll, so max write.
- contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training → read.

The security note says the security DB shows contractor with basic training, and that HR note said full_time but security record is contractor. So according to the security facts, the employee is contractor with basic training → max read.

Requested admin. Max is read (contractor basic training). Grant the maximum (read), not more than requested (admin; read < admin fine).

So decision: read.

Reason: conflicting notes; security record is contractor with basic training; contractors with basic training max at read; admin never allowed. Grant read.
